en: An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large religious procession on a cobblestoned street. Priests and participants carry large decorated banners with sacred images and crosses, surrounded by a crowd of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing. Historic urban buildings and a church tower rise in the background. Printed captions in Hungarian and German appear beneath the image.
